detailed_description: Resume Builder helps you assemble a resume directly in the browser. Add your name, title, contact details, summary, work experience, education, skills with levels, languages, and an optional photo. Choose from three templates: professional, minimal, and creative, then adjust the accent color. Use the edit and preview tabs to check the document before exporting it as a PDF. The tool provides structure and export, while the final wording, accuracy, and proofreading remain under your control.
usage_steps: Fill in your personal details, title, contact fields, and short summary.
Add work experience, education, skills, and languages as needed.
Upload a photo if you want one, then choose professional, minimal, or creative styling.
Open the preview tab to inspect the finished resume layout.
Use Export PDF when the resume is ready to save or share.
usage_examples: Create a first resume for an internship with education, projects, skills, and contact details.
Refresh a job-search resume by updating recent work experience and exporting a new PDF.
Prepare a clean one-page resume draft before manually proofreading every section.
Use the accent color and template selector to match a simple personal style.

faqs.question: How many templates are available?
faqs.answer: The current tool includes three template styles: professional, minimal, and creative.

faqs.question: Can I export the resume as PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the Export PDF button after reviewing the preview.

faqs.question: Does the tool write resume content for me?
faqs.answer: No. It gives you fields, layout, preview, and PDF export. You should review the wording and facts yourself.
